tasks.title: Design and implement data model and ontology
tasks.description: Define the core data entities, relationships, and normalization rules that will form the foundation of the system.
tasks.details:
Create a core/data_model.py module that defines the following classes:
- Restaurant: Basic restaurant information
- Recipe: Recipe structure with name, description, steps
- Ingredient: Components used in recipes
- RecipeUnit: Units used in recipes
- InventoryItem: Items in inventory
- InventoryUnit: Units used for inventory
- FamilyInventory: Grouping of inventory items
- CategoryRecipe: Grouping of recipes

Implement relationships between entities:
```python
class Recipe:
    def __init__(self, name, description, steps, category_id, ingredients=None):
        self.name = name
        self.description = description
        self.steps = steps
        self.category_id = category_id
        self.ingredients = ingredients or []

class Ingredient:
    def __init__(self, name, quantity, unit_id, inventory_item_id=None):
        self.name = name
        self.quantity = quantity
        self.unit_id = unit_id
        self.inventory_item_id = inventory_item_id
```

Define normalization rules for units and measures in core/normalization.py.
Implement semantic relations and taxonomies in core/taxonomy.py.
<info added on 2026-02-14T06:06:48.277Z>
<info added on 2026-02-13T08:15:22.456Z>
## Design References for Subtask 2.2 and 2.3

### Recipe.add_ingredient Method Enhancement
- When creating a new InventoryItem, require unit_id_for_inventory parameter
- This parameter must be a valid inventory unit ID (from valid_inventory_unit_ids)
- Makes inventory unit explicit and separate from recipe unit
- Caller responsibility to determine appropriate inventory unit via:
  - Same-unit match if applicable
  - User selection from valid inventory units
  - LLM-assisted determination

### InventoryUnit Equivalence System
- Add to InventoryUnit class:
  - base_unit_id (optional): Reference to another InventoryUnit that serves as base unit
  - factor_to_base (optional float): Conversion factor to the base unit
  - Example: 1 Caja (Box) = 10 kg, where kg is the base_unit_id and 10 is factor_to_base
- Implementation split:
  - Fields and basic validation in subtask 2.2 (entity relationships)
  - Conversion logic in subtask 2.3 (normalization.py)
- See .taskmaster/docs/inventory-units-and-equivalences-plan.md Parts 2 and 5 for detailed specifications

### Implementation Notes
- InventoryUnitRegistry should validate base_unit_id references
- Circular references in base units must be prevented
- Conversion methods should handle multi-step conversions through base units
</info added on 2026-02-13T08:15:22.456Z>
</info added on 2026-02-14T06:06:48.277Z>

Updated workflow for Recipe.add_ingredient method:

1. When an ingredient is added to a recipe, check if it already exists in the restaurant's inventory
2. If the ingredient already exists in inventory:
   - Link to the existing InventoryItem
   - No new InventoryItem is created
   - No LLM classification is needed
3. If the ingredient is NEW (not already in inventory):
   - The caller (e.g., Structuring agent) is responsible for:
     - Calling the LLM model to classify the ingredient as perishable ("perecedero") or non-perishable ("no perecedero")
     - Obtaining the appropriate InventoryCategory id based on this classification
     - Passing this category_id when creating the InventoryItem
   - The Recipe.add_ingredient method will:
     - Accept the ingredient and the LLM-determined category_id
     - Create a new InventoryItem with this category_id
     - Add the new InventoryItem to the restaurant's inventory
4. Implementation should include validation for the category_id parameter
5. The method should return the created or linked InventoryItem for reference

tasks.title: Clasificación section — Classification Agent and Gradio UI
tasks.description: Implement the Clasificación section: form fields (classification inputs) plus a single BaseAgent conversational chat. Agent suggests restaurant type, templates, and operational level. Reads Restaurant entity from DataLake (written by Task 7) and writes classification results back.
tasks.details:
Create core/agents/classification_agent.py:

```python
from core.agents.base_agent import BaseAgent

class ClassificationAgent(BaseAgent):
    def __init__(self, llm_provider):
        tools = [
            # Define tools for restaurant classification
            # Define tools for template suggestion
            # Define tools for operational-level diagnosis
        ]
        super().__init__("Classification Agent", llm_provider, tools)
    
    def run(self, input_data, context=None):
        prompt = self._generate_prompt(input_data, context)
        response = self.llm_provider.generate(prompt, tools=self.tools, structured_output=True)
        return self._process_response(response)
    
    def _generate_prompt(self, input_data, context):
        # Create prompt for restaurant classification and template suggestion
        return f"""You are Zenet's Classification Agent. Your role is to classify the restaurant type,
        suggest appropriate templates, and diagnose the operational level.
        
        Restaurant information: {input_data.get('restaurant_info', '')}
        
        Please classify the restaurant type, suggest appropriate templates for recipe categories
        and inventory families, and diagnose the operational level (accompaniment level,
        automation level, AI suggestions level, visible guides)."""
    
    def _process_response(self, response):
```

```python
from core.agents.base_agent import BaseAgent

class ConfigurationAgent(BaseAgent):
    def __init__(self, llm_provider):
        tools = [
            # Define tools for recipe category setup
            # Define tools for inventory family setup
            # Define tools for recipe units setup
            # Define tools for inventory units setup
            # Define tools for structure validation
        ]
        super().__init__("Configuration Agent", llm_provider, tools)
    
    def run(self, input_data, context=None):
        prompt = self._generate_prompt(input_data, context)
        response = self.llm_provider.generate(prompt, tools=self.tools, structured_output=True)
        return self._process_response(response)
    
    def _generate_prompt(self, input_data, context):
        # Create prompt for guided setup of recipe categories, inventory families, and units
        return f"""You are Zenet's Configuration Agent. Your role is to guide the setup of
        recipe categories, inventory families, recipe units, and inventory units for the restaurant.
        
        Restaurant type: {input_data.get('restaurant_type', '')}
        Selected templates: {input_data.get('selected_templates', [])}
        
        Please guide the setup of recipe categories, inventory families, recipe units, and inventory units
        based on the restaurant type and selected templates. Explain the importance of each category,
        family, and unit for normalization, future forecast, and distribution. Use standard units
        (e.g. g, kg, L, pza, caja) from the template without requiring the user to define them from scratch."""
    
    def _process_response(self, response):
        # Process the LLM response and extract structured information
        # Return a dictionary with configuration results
        return {
            "recipe_categories": configured_categories,
            "inventory_families": configured_families,
            "recipe_units": configured_recipe_units,
            "inventory_units": configured_inventory_units,
            "normalization_rules": normalization_rules,
```

```python
import gradio as gr
from gradio.components import Markdown, Button, File, Textbox
import subprocess
import os

def launch_notebook(notebook_path):
    subprocess.Popen(["jupyter", "notebook", notebook_path])

def create_ui():
    with gr.Blocks(title="Zenet MVP 0.1") as app:
        gr.Markdown("# Zenet MVP 0.1\nA primary cognitive operating system for restaurants")
        
        with gr.Tab("Welcome"):
            gr.Markdown("## Welcome to Zenet\nStart your journey to bring order to your restaurant operations.")
            welcome_button = gr.Button("Start Onboarding")
            welcome_button.click(lambda: launch_notebook("notebooks/bienvenida.ipynb"))
        
        with gr.Tab("Classification"):
            gr.Markdown("## Restaurant Classification\nClassify your restaurant and get suggested templates.")
            classification_button = gr.Button("Start Classification")
            classification_button.click(lambda: launch_notebook("notebooks/Clasificación.ipynb"))
        
        with gr.Tab("Configuration"):
            gr.Markdown("## Initial Configuration\nSet up recipe categories and inventory families.")
            configuration_button = gr.Button("Start Configuration")
            configuration_button.click(lambda: launch_notebook("notebooks/Configuración_inicial.ipynb"))
        
        with gr.Tab("Alignment"):
            gr.Markdown("## Data Alignment\nAlign your restaurant data with the configured structure.")
            alignment_button = gr.Button("Start Alignment")
            alignment_button.click(lambda: launch_notebook("notebooks/alineamiento.ipynb"))
        
        with gr.Tab("Structuring"):
            gr.Markdown("## Data Structuring\nCreate structured representations of recipes and ingredients.")
            structuring_button = gr.Button("Start Structuring")
            structuring_button.click(lambda: launch_notebook("notebooks/Estructura.ipynb"))
        
        with gr.Tab("Operational Manual"):
            gr.Markdown("## Operational Manual\nGenerate a digital operational manual and answer business questions.")
            manual_button = gr.Button("Start Operational Manual")
            manual_button.click(lambda: launch_notebook("notebooks/manual_operativo.ipynb"))
    
    return app

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app = create_ui()
    app.launch()
```

```python
        initial_state = {"restaurant_info": {"name": "Test Restaurant", "type": "Italian"}}
```
